plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says on Jesse Michels's podcast that deep underground military bases are real. He says they have been a major focus of the US Defense Department and the Army Corps of Engineers, the army's building branch, since 1948. That was when, he says, the US brought over Nazi scientists, among them Xavier Dorsch, head of Nazi Germany's construction agency known as the Todt organization, to work in an underground laboratory run by Air Materiel Command, the Air Force's research and equipment arm.
